# Docker: reference

Start, stop and prune containers, and check and upgrade Compose stacks. The guide is [README.md](README.md); this page lists every function, alias and command, as their own help prints it (`gash_help NAME`, `gash COMMAND --help`).

## Functions

| Function | Alias | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`docker_compose_check`](#docker_compose_check) | `dcc` | Check for available Docker Compose image updates |
| [`docker_compose_scan`](#docker_compose_scan) | `dcscan` | Scan directories for Docker Compose projects |
| [`docker_compose_upgrade`](#docker_compose_upgrade) | `dcup2` | Upgrade Docker Compose services to latest images |
| [`docker_prune_all`](#docker_prune_all) | `dpa` | Remove ALL Docker containers, images, volumes, and networks |
| [`docker_start_all`](#docker_start_all) | `daa` | Start all stopped Docker containers |
| [`docker_stop_all`](#docker_stop_all) | `dsa` | Stop all running Docker containers |
| [`llm_docker_check`](#llm_docker_check) |  | Docker Compose update check (JSON output for AI agents) |

### docker_compose_check

Check for available Docker Compose image updates.

Alias: `dcc`

#### Usage

```text
docker_compose_check [PATH] [--json] [--no-color]
```

#### Options

```text
PATH        Directory with the compose file (default: current directory)
--json      JSON output for scripting; errors are JSON envelopes on stderr
--no-color  Disable ANSI colors (auto-off on pipe, NO_COLOR, GASH_HEADLESS)
-h, --help  Show this help
```

#### Examples

```bash
# Check for updates in current directory
dcc

# Check a specific project
dcc /opt/myapp

# JSON output for scripting
dcc --json
```

#### Status codes

```text
CURRENT     Local image matches the remote digest
UPDATE      A newer image is on the registry
NOT_PULLED  The image is not pulled locally yet
PINNED      Digest pin or full version (e.g. nginx:1.25.3), not upgraded
ERROR       Registry unreachable, auth refused or invalid image reference
```

#### Notes

```text
Compose resolves the project files itself (compose.yaml first, override
files, COMPOSE_FILE); when `docker compose config` fails, the first of
compose.yaml, compose.yml, docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.yaml is
read.
Every registry is queried: Docker Hub and GHCR with a token (GITHUB_TOKEN
is exchanged for a GHCR token), the others anonymously, answering a
Bearer challenge. Image variables come from the exported environment
and DIR/.env, with Compose's interpolation rules; a quoted value in
DIR/.env that never closes is refused (invalid_env_file), as Compose
refuses the whole file.
The exit status is 0 whenever the report prints, ERROR rows included.
```

#### Registry errors

```text
The error field of an ERROR row (--json) is one of: dns_error,
connection_refused, timeout, ssl_error, transport_error, unauthorized,
forbidden, not_found, rate_limited, server_error, http_NNN (another
status), malformed_token, no_digest_in_response, registry_unreachable,
invalid_reference (the image name does not parse).
```

See also: [`docker_compose_upgrade`](../docker/reference.md#docker_compose_upgrade), [`docker_compose_scan`](../docker/reference.md#docker_compose_scan)

### docker_compose_scan

Scan directories for Docker Compose projects.

Alias: `dcscan`

#### Usage

```text
docker_compose_scan [BASEDIR] [-d|--depth N] [-j|--json] [--no-color]
```

#### Options

```text
BASEDIR     Base directory to scan (default: current directory)
-d, --depth N
            Maximum search depth, a non-negative integer (default: 3)
-j, --json  JSON output for scripting
--no-color  Disable ANSI colors
-h, --help  Show this help (first word only)
```

#### Examples

```bash
# Scan current directory for compose files
dcscan

# Scan /opt with limited depth
dcscan /opt --depth 2

# JSON output for scripting
dcscan /home/deploy --json

# Full audit: scan then check each project
dcscan /opt --depth 3
```

#### Notes

```text
An unknown option is refused with exit status 1.
```

See also: [`docker_compose_check`](../docker/reference.md#docker_compose_check), [`docker_compose_upgrade`](../docker/reference.md#docker_compose_upgrade)

### docker_compose_upgrade

Upgrade Docker Compose services to latest images.

Alias: `dcup2`

#### Usage

```text
docker_compose_upgrade [PATH] [--dry-run] [-f|--force] [-y|--yes] [--no-color]
```

#### Options

```text
PATH        Directory with the compose file (default: current directory)
--dry-run   Show what would be done without executing
-f, --force Upgrade pinned versions too
-y, --yes   Skip the confirmation (required in headless mode)
--no-color  Disable ANSI colors
-h, --help  Show this help
```

#### Examples

```bash
# Upgrade services with mutable tags (latest, main, dev)
dcup2

# Preview what would be upgraded without doing it
dcup2 --dry-run

# Force upgrade even for pinned versions
dcup2 --force

# Upgrade a specific project, no question asked
dcup2 /opt/myapp --yes
```

#### Notes

```text
Only upgrades services with mutable tags (latest, main, dev, etc.).
Pinned versions (e.g. nginx:1.25.3) are skipped unless --force is used.
Pulls new images, recreates affected containers, removes old images.
Compose runs in PATH with its own file discovery, so override files
(docker-compose.override.yml) and COMPOSE_FILE are honored.
Headless (GASH_HEADLESS=1) it refuses to run without --yes.
Declining the confirmation returns 1.
```

See also: [`docker_compose_check`](../docker/reference.md#docker_compose_check), [`docker_compose_scan`](../docker/reference.md#docker_compose_scan)

### docker_prune_all

Remove ALL Docker containers, images, volumes, and networks.

Alias: `dpa`

#### Usage

```text
docker_prune_all [-y] [--dry-run]
```

#### Examples

```bash
# Nuclear cleanup (interactive confirmation)
dpa

# Only count what would go
dpa --dry-run
```

#### Notes

```text
WARNING: This is destructive. It will:
  1. Stop all running containers
  2. Remove all containers
  3. Remove all images
  4. Remove all volumes (DATA LOSS)
  5. Remove all networks
  6. Run docker system prune
You will be asked for confirmation before proceeding; -y skips it.
Declining returns 1. Built-in networks (bridge, host, none) stay.
```

See also: [`docker_stop_all`](../docker/reference.md#docker_stop_all)

### docker_start_all

Start all stopped Docker containers.

Alias: `daa`

#### Usage

```text
docker_start_all [-y]
```

#### Examples

```bash
# Start all stopped containers
daa

# Restart everything
dsa && daa
```

#### Notes

```text
Lists the stopped containers (Will start N container(s): NAMES)
and asks before acting; -y/--yes skips the question and is required
headless or without a terminal. Declining returns 1.
```

See also: [`docker_stop_all`](../docker/reference.md#docker_stop_all)

### docker_stop_all

Stop all running Docker containers.

Alias: `dsa`

#### Usage

```text
docker_stop_all [-y]
```

#### Examples

```bash
# Stop every running container
dsa

# Restart all containers: stop then start
dsa && daa
```

#### Notes

```text
Lists the running containers (Will stop N container(s): NAMES)
and asks before acting; -y/--yes skips the question and is required
headless or without a terminal. Declining returns 1.
```

See also: [`docker_start_all`](../docker/reference.md#docker_start_all), [`docker_prune_all`](../docker/reference.md#docker_prune_all)

### llm_docker_check

Docker Compose update check (JSON output for AI agents).

Replaces:

- `docker compose pull --dry-run; docker images`

#### Usage

```text
llm_docker_check [PATH]
```

#### Examples

```bash
# Check for updates (JSON output)
llm_docker_check

# Check a specific path
llm_docker_check /opt/myapp
```

#### Notes

```text
Wrapper around docker_compose_check --json.
Designed for LLM/AI agent consumption.
PATH follows the llm_* path rules (no .., no protected trees).
${VAR} in the compose file is resolved from PATH/.env and a short
allowlist (HOME, USER, PATH, LANG, DOCKER_HOST, ...), never from
other exported variables, so a token cannot reach the output.
```

See also: [`docker_compose_check`](../docker/reference.md#docker_compose_check)
